pro_course_detail.title: English for School Writing
pro_course_detail.description:
I am a native speaker with a midwestern American accent, and I have taught in grade schools, colleges and as an online tutor.

This lesson is for children in 6th through 12th grade who are fluent or almost fluent in English. It will be tailored to meet your child’s unique needs and interests, focusing on improving your child’s understanding of grammar and adding to their vocabulary. I do not intend to teach grammar or vocabulary until I know what they need. I will teach them how to write clearly and vividly as well as how to write strong arguments. In most cases, this will include teaching them logic (argumentation) and outline writing. If your child needs to work on their pronunciation, I can help with that, too.

I teach using my own resources and your child’s corrected work, as well as any writing they do for me. I develop my own Google docs resources to share with students to help them with grammar, vocabulary, etc., and I share those with students and parents via gmail. When your child has written something for a class or taken a grammar or vocabulary test and doesn’t understand what they got wrong, they can share those documents with me so that I can explain and teach them how to avoid mistakes.
  
If your child needs help with  pronunciation, they’ll read articles about topics they’re interested in or resources I’ve shared with them to me. As they make pronunciation mistakes, I’ll correct their pronunciation and give them exercises to complete as homework when needed to improve their pronunciation.

Please let me know if you have any questions about my teaching methods, and please consider having your children take a trial lesson with me to help you all get an idea of whether you think I would be a good fit. 

I look forward to meeting you!

teacher_info.introduction:
My name is Dr. Rod Rogers. 

I am from the United States, but currently live and work in Guadalajara, Mexico. 

FOCUS 
I help you achieve your English learning goals as quickly and enjoyably as possible. I minimize the use of complex grammar lessons and focus on fun, understandable conversation without anxiety. I follow Stephen Krashen's "Comprehensible Input Theory of language learning"--"Language acquisition does not require extensive use of conscious grammatical rules, and does not require tedious drill....The best methods are therefore those that supply 'comprehensible input' in low anxiety situations, containing messages that students really want to hear." 

QUALIFICATIONS 
TEFL certifications in both General and Business English. I have been a life-long learner of languages. I have studied Portuguese, mastered biblical Greek and Hebrew, and currently am learning to speak Spanish. I have presented thousands of lessons and speeches all around the world. I have Bachelor's, Master's, and Doctor's degrees in Bible, Old Testament and Semitic Languages, and Communications. I am the published author of three books and one short fiction story. 


WHAT MAKES ME A SPECIAL TEACHER IS... 
* my sense of humor--we will always have fun! 
* my genuine concern to help you learn 
* my in-depth knowledge of the English language gained in earning two advanced degrees 
* my experience in writing and publishing several books 
* my 35 years of teaching experience in schools, in churches, and as a professional speaker 
* my understanding of how to learn a language

CLASS PROCEDURE
I have many back to back classes. So, in order to start each class on time, my policy is to provide a brief summary of our lesson 5 minutes before the class ends, and to close our connection 2 minutes early. This gives each student the maximum time possible.

I began teaching in Taiwan in 2009, doing conversation groups at Shih Hsin University. This challenged me immediately, and I still look back on it as a period of growth. A few years later I had the honor and privilege to teach a semester in Korea at a kindergarten, dancing and singing the days away with some fun little ones! 

Then in 2014, the big challenge: starting a new program in Longaví, Chile, from scratch...I was the first ever native English speaker at two rural schools! Los Cristales and La Quinta will forever be in my heart, for their warm welcome and eagerness to get down to business and educate the kids, despite all the challenges of living in a remote location. 3 years later, both of these schools have thriving ESL programs in an area of South America where native speakers are few and far between. This was a great privilege. After that came an elective at a public high school on travel English, a continued position at a private school in Linares where I live, and a lot of fun teaching adults from all professional backgrounds. The most important thing for me is to remain positive and upbeat as a teacher, and always challenge the students. Lecture is boring...I want the student involved. 

Adults love to talk and forcing them to talk in their 2nd language is the ONLY way to gain verbal fluency. Vocabulary lessons are indeed important, and that vocabulary needs to be put into context....through topical conversation. I can´t wait to help out students on italki, as I´ve been able to help hundreds of Chilean, Korean and Taiwanese students before them. This is my passion.

pro_course_detail.title: Let's Talk! 100% Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
How do you learn to speak a foreign language? Practice, practice, practice! The more you speak, the better you will become. My goal is to provide a fun and engaging environment for you to practice speaking with the guidance of a professional teacher.

Throughout the lesson, I will identify and correct any consistent errors and give you suggestions for more natural phrases to use. I will share a private document with you that will contain all vocabulary and phrases learned throughout the lessons. 

If you are an upper beginner or lower intermediate learner, I will speak slowly and clearly, and we will work on building your confidence, vocabulary, and fluency skills. 

If you are an upper intermediate or advanced learner, I will challenge you by speaking at a native or near-native speed and level, and I invite you to challenge yourself in each lesson to use phrases or new vocabulary that you may be unsure of.

You are encouraged to ask as many questions as you’d like throughout the lesson (Example: Can you repeat that phrase? What does that mean? How is my pronunciation? Can I use “______” in this context? What is the difference between “______” and “_______”?)

Please note: I do not offer classes for children at this time.
